mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day returns in easing periods not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in the unemployment rate above 4.6% triggers a negative feedback response in equity markets, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises above 4.6% in the next month
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain negative despite UNRATE crossing above 4.6%, or p-value >0.05 in t-test comparing to baseline.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate and decrease in unemployment rate signals a tightening labor market coupled with monetary policy tightening, amplifying discount rate pressures on equities and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises AND UNRATE falls in the next month
regime_hint: tightening labor and monetary policy cycle
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (p >0.05) despite the interaction, or Rank IC <0.03 over 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion characterized by high demand growth (GDPC1) and suppressed supply growth (INDPRO), S&P 500 forward returns exhibit positive momentum over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly positive (p>0.05) in late-cycle expansion periods, or Rank IC <0.03 over 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained downward trend in the unemployment rate below 4.6% signals labor market strength, reducing risk premiums and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly positive (p>0.05) despite UNRATE decline, or Rank IC <0.03 over 1-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden surge in monthly demand units (HOUST) above 2000 triggers a positive equity market response as investors anticipate sustained economic activity and corporate earnings growth over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rises above 2000 units in the next month
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (p>0.05) despite the surge, or Rank IC <0.03 over 2-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in the federal funds rate and contraction in supply growth (INDPRO) indicates tightening monetary policy and reduced business investment, paradoxically amplifying risk premium compression and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises AND INDPRO falls in the next month
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly positive (p>0.05) despite the interaction, or Rank IC <0.03 over 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in the unemployment rate below 4.5% triggers a positive equity market reaction as investors anticipate labor market recovery and reduced inflationary pressures over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 4.5% in the next month
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (p>0.05) despite the drop below 4.5%, or Rank IC <0.03 over 2-month window.
